Predicates:
RomanceLanguage(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropeanLanguage(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguagesInFamily(x,y) ::: x is a language in the same family as y.
French ::: French is a Romance language.
Spanish ::: Spanish is a Romance language.
German ::: German is a language.
Basque ::: Basque is a language.
Related(x,y) ::: x is related to y.
NotRelated(x,y) ::: x is not related to y.
Premises:
∀x (RomanceLanguage(x) → IndoEuropeanLanguage(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
∀x (LanguagesInFamily(x, y) → Related(x, y)) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
RomanceLanguage(French) ::: French is a Romance language.
RomanceLanguage(Spanish) ::: Spanish is a Romance language.
Related(German, Spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
NotRelated(Basque, y) ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
Conclusion:
RomanceLanguage(Basque)
